name: 宣纸墨韵
description: 仿宋 + 墨黑 + 印章红，宣纸米底 #F8F4E8 上的东方古典书卷风。借鉴 github.com/GordenSun/WX 的组合方法：H1 居中双细线、H2 左墨竖条、H3 虚线底印章红、blockquote 居中上下线。适合读书笔记/文论/古典深度文。

styles.h1: font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #1F1A14; text-align: center; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 34px; margin-bottom: 22px; border-top: 1px solid #8B1F1F; border-bottom: 1px solid #8B1F1F; letter-spacing: 2px; font-family: 'FangSong','STFangsong','仿宋',serif;
styles.h2: font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; color: #1F1A14; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 16px; padding-left: 14px; border-left: 4px solid #1F1A14; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: 'FangSong','STFangsong','仿宋',serif;
styles.h3: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #8B1F1F; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 12px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px dashed #8B1F1F;
styles.h4: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; color: #8B1F1F; line-height: 1.6; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 10px;
styles.h5: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #4A3F2E; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.6;
styles.h6: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #7A6A4F; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #1F1A14; line-height: 1.95; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: font-size: 15px; color: #4A3F2E; line-height: 1.9; text-align: center; font-style: italic; border-top: 1px solid #8B1F1F; border-bottom: 1px solid #8B1F1F; background: transparent;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 15px; color: #4A3F2E; line-height: 1.9; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 0.5px; background: transparent; font-style: italic;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 2px; display: block; border: 1px solid #D9CFB6; background: transparent; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 36px; height: 1px; width: 40%; background: #8B1F1F; border: none;
styles.code: background: transparent; border: 1px solid #8B1F1F; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 92%; color: #8B1F1F; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.pre: background: #FAF5E6; border: 1px solid #D9CFB6; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #1F1A14; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; background: #EFE5CC; color: #4A3F2E; font-size: 12px;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #1F1A14; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #8B1F1F;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: #8B1F1F; background: #EFE5CC; border-bottom: 1px solid #8B1F1F;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #1F1A14; line-height: 1.95; letter-spacing: 0.5px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #7A6A4F; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
